# Heterarchic

> Machine-readable entry point and index for AI agents interacting with the Heterarchic repository and architecture.

## Core Entry Points

- [Heterarchic Repository](https://github.com/edrewes/heterarchic): Source code, architecture documents, and issue tracker.
- [README & Overview](https://github.com/edrewes/heterarchic#readme): System design and entry point documentation.

## Agent Resolution

- Follows the standard /llms.txt specification as a deterministic root entry point for AI agents.
- Validated via [AccessGuard AI-Readiness Suite](https://ronanchnlps-bit.github.io/).
